problems.form_value: Deepseek and Dreamina; model versions not stated.
problems.source_says: The blanket statement that model versions are not stated overlooks version labels in the Dreamina screenshots: Figure 6 displays an image-model selector labeled Images 4.5, and Figure 7 displays Images 4.1 in the generated-image information row. These are screenshot labels, not confirmation of which version every participant used or of a single version used throughout the experiment; the Methods prose does not establish those details.
problems.locator: p. 7, Figure 6, bottom toolbar within the red Parameter setting box (quoted label, inspected in the PDF image); p. 8, Figure 7, generated-image information row displays 图片 4.1. Both labels were inspected at enlarged resolution directly from the PDF without creating image files.

confirmed.statement: S1 explicitly reports random assignment: "All students in the selected classes were then randomly assigned to one of three groups:"; the following list names GAI-SDTS, GAI, and TDL.
confirmed.locator: p. 4, section 3.2, Population and sampling; also section 3.1 on p. 4.

confirmed.statement: Three of six classes were sampled, then students were assigned to conditions and reorganized into mixed-class groups; individual assignment is supported rather than assignment of intact classes.
confirmed.locator: p. 4, section 3.2, first paragraph and paragraph beginning A four-week intensive practical course.

confirmed.statement: Participants independently created their own card-game characters using their assigned tools; the intervention changed assistance during production, not merely whose output raters evaluated.
confirmed.locator: p. 4, sections 3.2-3.3; p. 9, section 3.5; p. 11, section 5.1 explicitly describes students using AI to generate and refine visual outputs.

confirmed.statement: Both AI arms had access to Deepseek and Dreamina: Deepseek generated and refined character concepts through dialogue, while Dreamina provided text-to-image and image-to-image generation and visual refinement.
confirmed.locator: p. 5, section 3.3, paragraphs beginning Students in the TDL group and During the Define phase; pp. 6-7, Develop and Deliver phases; Figures 4, 6, and 7.

confirmed.statement: GAI-SDTS used the Double Diamond-Based Design Operation Sheet across Discover, Define, Develop, and Deliver; GAI used the same tools freely without structured design guidance.
confirmed.locator: p. 5, section 3.3, paragraphs beginning However, the main difference and The DDDOS; p. 9, section 3.5 and Figure 8.

confirmed.statement: TDL used printed and online references, hand-drawn sketches, and conventional software such as Photoshop, explicitly without GAI tools or explicit design-thinking strategies.
confirmed.locator: p. 4, section 3.2, condition (3); p. 5, section 3.3; p. 9, section 3.5 and Figure 8.

confirmed.statement: Both AI arms received 90 minutes of operational tool training before the design tasks; Figure 8 shows 40 participants in each of the three arms, matching Table 1.
confirmed.locator: p. 8, section 3.5, continuing onto p. 9; p. 9, Figure 8 (inspected) and Table 1 (PDF text and PyMuPDF table extraction); p. 4, section 3.2 reports 120 students.

confirmed.statement: The design has separate participant groups throughout the intervention; repeated questionnaires do not constitute a crossover, so randomized condition order is not applicable.
confirmed.locator: p. 4, sections 3.1-3.2; pp. 8-9, section 3.5; p. 9, Figure 8.

confirmed.statement: The quasi-experimental label is present, as the form acknowledges, alongside explicit individual random assignment; the paper does not describe sequence generation or allocation implementation.
confirmed.locator: pp. 3-4, section 3.1; p. 4, section 3.2; full Methods, sections 3.1-3.5.

summary: The PDF explicitly supports individual random assignment to two generative-AI assistance arms and a non-AI arm for students' own design work. Eligibility holds, but the form's claim that model versions are unstated overlooks Dreamina version labels visible in Figures 6 and 7; experiment-wide versions remain unconfirmed.
